source.body:
## Owner intent (2026-11-12 KST)

Build https://ekodi.kr/ekodimall/?q=... as single ordered discovery: first Mall verified products; second approved official suppliers such as Domeggook/Domemae only when licensing and readiness allow; third trusted external comparison as links only; fourth AI sourcing request (read-only/consent); fifth checkout only under existing authorized gates.

Preserve quote-verified bookstore, affiliate external checkout, approved provider identity, no fake hose-reel products or fabricated prices. No new public paid API, no cross-tenant data, no supplier buyer PII handoff or global auto-order enablement.

## Email evidence

Latest techsupport@ggook.com 2026-11-03: setOrder v4.3 member error may be malformed deliinfo, Domemae supply orders require registered business buyer. Follow-up remains DRAFT since 2026-11-04. 8000P scheduled expiry 2026-11-08; actual balance on 2026-11-12 unknown. Latest 2026-11-09 email is educational promotion, not technical.

## Delivery and governance

AI-ORCHESTRATE-001: enter through EKODI AI; isolated agent branch, permission checks, vendor scope, tests and responsive 320/390/768/1080/1440, npm run doctor, required CI, exact SHA protected PR, staging, production live verification. This issue is intent only, not purchase authority or production override. Keep payments/auto-orders/PII OFF and account scope restricted. Browser design mockup was not a deployment.

No direct push to protected main or payment/credential changes. If supplier API not permitted, show truthful unavailable state and approved outbound comparison links; never call unsupported private endpoints.

comments.text: [EKODI AI follow-up, 2026-11-12 13:xx KST] Read-only production browser verification completed on https://ekodi.kr/ekodimall/?q=자동%20릴%20호스: four search stages are visible and public supplier endpoint returns {"enabled":false,"state":"rights-unverified","items":[],"checkoutReady":false}. E-money 50,000 KRW remains available but is a separate prepaid balance, NOT approved for current purchase, and was untouched. Therefore 8,000P points-based purchase test cannot proceed; do not substitute e-money, charge card, or trigger setOrder without new financial authorization. Latest vendor API tech response remains 2026-11-03; 2026-11-04 follow-up is draft not sent; no new technical response in searched mail through 2026-11-12. Official supplier public catalog display rights and rate-limiter approval remain unverified and should remain OFF.
